title: mmRAG: A Modular Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
reasoning: The paper focuses on building and evaluating a technical benchmark for multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. It analyzes retrieval accuracy and query routing across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. There is no component related to evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
